search_text: published ZDI-22-1705 ZDI-CAN-19463 D-Link DIR-825/EE xupnpd Vimeo Plugin Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2022-12-28 CVE-2022-43646 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-43646 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['D-Link'] ['DIR-825'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DIR-825/EE routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Vimeo plugin for the xupnpd service, which listens on TCP port 4044. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the admin user. D-Link has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: D-Link DIR-825/EE xupnpd Vimeo Plugin Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DIR-825/EE routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Vimeo plugin for the xupnpd service, which listens on TCP port 4044. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the admin user.
